response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong software engineering credentials with nearly 17 years of experience and recent Staff-level roles, he lacks the essential domain expertise required for this Principal Performance Architect position. The role specifically requires deep experience in SoC and IP modeling, hardware-software co-design, GPU architecture analysis, and AI accelerator optimization—areas where the candidate has no demonstrated background. His career has been entirely focused on full-stack web development, backend services, and DevOps infrastructure, not hardware design or performance optimization at the hardware level. This represents a fundamental domain mismatch rather than a bridgeable skills gap.
strengths: Strong senior-level software engineering track record with ~17 years of experience and recent Staff positions demonstrating IC leadership capability
Proven ability to optimize performance in demanding environments, including microservices handling millions of requests and low-latency application development at Dunnhumby
Demonstrated ability to master diverse technical domains and programming languages across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure systems
concerns: Complete absence of hardware design, SoC modeling, IP architecture experience, or hardware description language expertise despite these being core role requirements
No demonstrated expertise in GPU architecture, AI accelerators, deep learning workload optimization, or computer architecture design—all critical to the position
Career entirely rooted in software development (web, backend, DevOps) with no evidence of transition into hardware design, performance modeling, or systems-level hardware optimization
